drivers: Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries (Ras Tanura, Rabigh)
Petcoke rally above US$100; anode prices up
outlooks.summary: Middle East attacks on refineries and shipping risks could tighten sour-crude and coke supply. The price is down 16% over 3 months but still up 22% on the year, so part of the rally may already be priced in. Some restarts (Flint Hills) and wide heavy-crude discounts limit the upside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether attacks on Saudi refineries and Hormuz shipping continue, and whether Brent holds near $110.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中东对炼厂和航运的袭击可能收紧高硫原油和焦炭供应。价格3个月下跌16%,但12个月仍上涨22%,部分涨幅可能已被消化。部分炼厂焦化装置复产(Flint Hills)以及重质原油大幅贴水限制了上行空间。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂(Ras Tanura、Rabigh)
霍尔木兹袭击推动布伦特原油接近110美元
石油焦涨至100美元上方,阳极价格走高
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注对沙特炼厂和霍尔木兹航运的袭击是否持续,以及布伦特原油能否维持在110美元附近。

drivers: Hawkish Fed and rising real rates
Hot US CPI lifting dollar and yields
outlooks.summary: Gold is a macro-driven market and headlines show no supply shortage. Price pressure comes from hawkish Fed expectations, although strong central bank buying gives some support.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next US inflation data and Fed signals on rate hikes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 黄金主要受宏观因素驱动,新闻中没有供应短缺迹象。价格压力来自美联储鹰派预期,不过央行持续购金提供一定支撑。
drivers_zh: 美联储转鹰、实际利率上升
美国CPI超预期推高美元和收益率
高盛下调黄金价格预测
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注下一次美国通胀数据以及美联储关于加息的信号。

drivers: Chinese miner suspends DR Congo operations
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are sharply cutting cobalt supply and a Chinese miner has suspended operations. The price fell 24% in 3 months, but it is up 26% on the year, and the quota squeeze points to renewed upside. China's extension of the export-control pause is a mild offset.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and export volumes for the coming quarter.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额大幅削减钴供应,一家中国矿企已暂停运营。价格3个月下跌24%,但12个月上涨26%,配额收紧显示价格可能再度上行。中国延长出口管制暂停期略有抵消。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额削减产量(嘉能可下降52%)
中国矿企暂停刚果(金)业务
中国出口管制暂停延长至2027年
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整及未来一个季度的出口量。

drivers: Copper-moly major slows moly output growth
outlooks.summary: Reports point to a deepening deficit and slower output growth from a major producer. Price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% on the year, so some of this is priced in, but supply remains tight.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China mine inspections and any change in producer output guidance.
outlooks.summary_zh: 报道显示供应缺口扩大,一家大型生产商放缓钼产量增长。价格3个月已涨18%、12个月涨42%,部分已被消化,但供应仍然偏紧。
drivers_zh: 供应缺口扩大
铜钼巨头放缓钼产量增长
中国矿山检查及出口管制不确定性
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国矿山检查以及主要生产商产量指引的变化。

outlooks.summary: Many headlines repeat India's black mass export ban, which is a small supply factor. No major mine or production outage is reported, and the price has already pulled back from highs.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether other countries copy India's recycling-material export curbs.
outlooks.summary_zh: 大量新闻重复报道印度禁止黑粉出口,这是一个较小的供应因素。没有重大矿山或产能中断的报道,且价格已从高位回落。
drivers_zh: 印度禁止黑粉出口
泰国与缅甸就污染问题磋商
价格3个月下跌13%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注其他国家是否效仿印度限制回收材料出口。

drivers: Japan yttrium supply stalled by Chinese curbs
outlooks.summary: China's curbs on Japan have stalled yttrium supply and Japan may run out within months. China's extension of the export-control suspension eases broader pressure, so risk is concentrated in heavy rare earths like yttrium.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China eases licences for Japan and how yttrium prices move.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国对日本的限制使钇供应停滞,日本可能数月内耗尽库存。中国延长出口管制暂停缓解了整体压力,因此风险集中在钇等重稀土。
drivers_zh: 中国管制导致日本钇供应停滞
中日出口管制紧张
中国延长出口管制暂停(抵消因素)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否放宽对日本的许可,以及钇价格走势。

outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are squeezing supply, and Myanmar mine issues add risk. The price is up 56% on the year but flat over 3 months, so further upside is possible if disruptions persist.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and the Congo conflict.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产正在挤压供应,缅甸矿山问题增加风险。价格12个月上涨56%,但3个月基本持平,若中断持续仍有上行可能。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产
缅甸矿山污染问题
中国矿山检查
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量和刚果冲突进展。

outlooks.summary: Headlines are mostly generic critical-mineral stories with little antimony-specific news. China's extended suspension and a price down 56% over 12 months suggest ample supply for now.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for any change to China's antimony export licensing.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻多为泛关键矿产内容,锑的专门信息很少。中国延长暂停出口管制,且价格12个月下跌56%,显示目前供应较为充足。
drivers_zh: 中国延长出口管制暂停
锑出口期限相关新闻
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国锑出口许可是否有变化。

drivers: China critical mineral export policy risk
Rising indium prices and tight by-product supply
outlooks.summary: Supply depends on China's export policy and by-product output, and tightness shows up in related metals like indium. The price is already up 67% in 3 months, so much is priced in, but risks remain. The extended suspension is a partial offset.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export licensing decisions and mining inspections.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应取决于中国出口政策和副产品产出,铟等相关金属已显现紧张。价格3个月已涨67%,大部分已被消化,但风险仍在。暂停期延长是部分抵消因素。
drivers_zh: 中国关键矿产出口政策风险
铟价上涨、副产品供应偏紧
光学/半导体材料需求强劲
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口许可决定及矿山检查。

drivers: Anode prices above RMB 6,000 on feedstock rally
outlooks.summary: Refinery attacks and high crude prices tighten green coke feedstock, which feeds CPC. Price is up 15%, so some is priced in, but further upside is possible if disruptions continue.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Middle East refinery attacks and Chinese anode demand for coke.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂遭袭和原油价格高企收紧生焦原料,进而影响煅烧焦。价格已上涨15%,部分已被消化,但若中断持续仍可能进一步上行。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂
霍尔木兹袭击推动布伦特接近110美元
原料上涨带动阳极价格突破6000元
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中东炼厂遇袭情况以及中国阳极对焦炭的需求。

drivers: US refinery outages (Deer Park) vs coker restart
outlooks.summary: The same refinery and shipping disruptions point to tighter coke supply. The index is down 5% over 3 months but up 46% on the year, and mixed restarts and outages keep confidence low.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Brent, Gulf refinery attacks and US coker operating rates.
outlooks.summary_zh: 同样的炼厂和航运中断指向焦炭供应收紧。该指数3个月下跌5%,但12个月上涨46%,复产与停产消息并存,因此信心较低。
drivers_zh: 中东炼厂遇袭
布伦特原油接近110美元
美国炼厂停产(Deer Park)与焦化装置复产并存
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注布伦特原油、海湾炼厂遇袭情况以及美国焦化装置开工率。
